title: The first audio radio broadcast
summary: Reginald Fessenden's Christmas Eve transmission carried voice and music over radio, opening a new mass-communication era.

title: The Second Hague Peace Conference opens
summary: Delegates from 44 states debate arbitration, the laws of war and the limits of great-power competition.

title: The Anglo-Russian Entente
summary: Britain and Russia settle colonial disputes in Persia, Afghanistan and Tibet, completing the Triple Entente.

title: The Panic of 1907 begins
summary: A failed attempt to corner United Copper exposes fragile trust-company balance sheets and triggers a nationwide liquidity scramble.

title: The Knickerbocker Trust collapses
summary: New York's third-largest trust suspends payments. J.P. Morgan helps organise a private rescue as the crisis spreads.

title: Lehman Brothers files for bankruptcy
summary: The largest bankruptcy in US history freezes global credit markets and forces a new era of central-bank intervention.

title: The Mumbai attacks
summary: A coordinated attack on India's financial capital raises security and sovereign-risk premiums across the region.

title: The Satyam accounting scandal
summary: India's fourth-largest IT services firm reveals a billion-dollar accounting fraud, testing corporate-governance confidence.

title: India's national election result
summary: A decisive mandate lifts political-risk discounts and helps trigger a sharp re-rating in Indian equities.
